title: Quietly Charred Spanish Rice Arroz Negro
description: A charred, pillowy, brunch mood Spanish dish featuring sweet rice flour chapssalgaru, mirepoix base, and dash friendly ingredients, formed into arroz negro.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the diced onion, carrot, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked vegetables, sweet rice flour, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Gradually add the water to the bowl, stirring constantly to avoid lumps.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake the mixture in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until the top is lightly charred.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
